remaining_gaps: Completion date of the District of Columbia water mains (Twenty-first Street, Virginia Avenue, New York Avenue, E, B and Seventeenth Streets, Missouri Avenue and the Mall) is not held. Source needed: Report of the Commissioners of the District of Columbia for fiscal year 1918 or 1919 (Water Department), or the Engineer Commissioner's report.

The order names no suspension statute; whether it rests on the naval appropriation act of March 4, 1917 (39 Stat. 1192) proviso or on war powers is not shown, so whether the joint resolution of March 3, 1921 (Pub. Res. 64, 41 Stat. 1359; lead X1-E1) reached it cannot be decided. Source needed: text of Pub. Res. 64 (not held; X1-E1 is source_pending).
Overtime pay under the proviso is an accrued effect for work done; it does not set an end.

Completion date of the reconstruction of Vault No. 17, Treasury Building, is not held. Source needed: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury or of the Supervising Architect for fiscal year 1918 or 1919.

Whether the March 4, 1917 proviso ('in cases of national emergency') was ended or reached by the joint resolution of March 3, 1921 (Pub. Res. 64, 41 Stat. 1359; lead X1-E1) must be shown; its text is not held.

Completion date of the Boston Immigrant Station buildings is not held. Source needed: Annual Report of the Supervising Architect of the Treasury for fiscal year 1919 or 1920, or the Commissioner General of Immigration's annual report.
Whether the March 4, 1917 proviso was ended or reached by the joint resolution of March 3, 1921 (Pub. Res. 64, 41 Stat. 1359; lead X1-E1) must be shown; its text is not held.
Completion date of the Barge Office contracts is not held. Source needed: Annual Report of the Supervising Architect of the Treasury for fiscal year 1919.

The end of the 'present national emergency' for this order must be shown from a source naming it or the March 4, 1917 proviso; the joint resolution of March 3, 1921 (Pub. Res. 64, 41 Stat. 1359; lead X1-E1) is the candidate and its text is not held. Until both dates are held the first end cannot be fixed or bounded beyond 'after November 18, 1918'.
